2026-05-17.notes: maria and ichiko sang me to sleep as i rolled around in bed in a semi-conscious state. i started the day off with my imogen playlist + songs i randomly felt an urge to listen to (boom clap, beggin' on your knees, xanny family). i default to starting my ichiko playlist whenever i step foot in a museum but i opted to just listen to seabed eden on loop today. my sleep quality was not great so i haven't been able to be as present as i'd like to be, both in general and in terms of listening to music...i want to try to listen with more intention tomorrow and try to set aside at least half an hour for checking out new albums and artists!

2026-05-18.notes: not a very notable day overall but i was finally well enough to go to class (double middle fingers @ lupus!). it'd been a while since i got to enjoy reading while listening to my Commute Reading song™️ ("2EM17_KK_A08", beautiful little tune by shiro sagisu for the evangelion rebuilds, originally composed for and used in for Kare Kano); i'm slowly but surely feeling more like myself day by day. got a soulja boy itch out of nowhere midday; listening to all his classics revived me + reminded me of my time in hawaii last spring...my friend kayla exclusively listened to sir soulja all of spring break. the black eyed peas + alice also helped me get through this murky monkeyless monday. no new music...maybe tomorrow

2026-05-19.notes: started off strong w a couple new artists and songs (though i must admit that i don't really remember any of them). "2EM17_KK_A08" is really skewing my listening data since i just have it on loop as i read in transit...i'm also realizing (for the 300th time) that ~50% of the songs i listen to are the ones that defined 2024 summer + fall for me; it's bittersweet that most, if not all of these songs will be forever tinged by the deepest, darkest blues i ever found myself in (so far), but the blues have faded and are not visible to most :^] i want to, need to make more of an effort to listen to new + more upbeat songs but i always find my way back to the marias' submarine. i feel stuck but that's okay (for now)

2026-05-20.notes: happy hump day! the avalanches' latest release played the biggest role in making my hump day happy: to me,"together" is like hugging your friend you haven't seen in eons then going on a sunset drive down a street lined with sweet magnolia trees with all the windows down on a friday night. i'd like to think that it evened out the blue tunes i started my day with (i wish i didn't feel most in my element when listening to whispy, wistful songs). switched my default studying song ("dearly beloved" from kingdom hearts 2) for "paul's theme" by men i trust. equus asinus is the only album i consider perfect (i don't even consider submarine perfect...) and i wish i could listen to all of it for the first time.

2026-05-21.notes: absolutely conked out without meaning to on my beanbag at ~6pm last night; woke up at 2 very disoriented + my eyes dry and bloodshot from sleeping with my contacts in...got myself out of bed by revisiting an old playlist that is very dear to me ("i've stubbed my toe once again", made by yours truly the fall of 2024). i've forgotten just how much i adore the cardigans. had to clean, shower, get ready, and pack in a hurry to get to union station to meet my friend. i remember putting my airpods in the second i spotted them but didn't realize that i didn't listen to any music afterwards. i love 1:1 time with friends + value being fully present so i guess it's unsurprising. we were in conversation all day; highlights include playing ispy on the train, trying speciality coffee ('lana del fog' was lifechanging for my friend), and finally checking out the milwaukee art museum.

2026-05-22.notes: spent the entire day exploring milwaukee while conversing with my friend; didn't listen to music until we were on the train back to chi and until my friend fell asleep. we jammed out to songs from the 70s at the cafe we went to for breakfast and later serenaded with polka music (a very pleasant surprise) at a brewery. i'd made a mental note to myself last night about remembering to play and enjoy music as i was getting ready, packing, etc. but (clearly) forgot...just an effect of good conversation.

2026-05-23.notes: slept in + spent the entire day at the zoo with my friend; was (once again) in conversation all day. would've been listening to music if i'd gone alone, kinda crazy that i didn't listen to anything as i was both getting ready and unready (but again i wasn't alone...). i guess i'm never alone even when i'm alone because i'm always in the good company of music
